title: An agent changes a playtest value

steps.text: The lazy catalog describes defaults beside their owners. Exposure uses its Local binding; the cosmetic spring captures an Owner profile on the next action.
Haul yield submits a bounded lockstep request with its expected revision. The server checks its explicitly assigned controller. Queued is not applied; refusals have correlated receipts.

The eight haul keys apply at their stamped tick and remain hashed. Rail values instead go through the ordered server command boundary: the server applies on arrival, checkpoints a commit before acknowledging it, and both peers mirror its global tuneValue and tuneRev rows. Development shape changes reset the namespace.

Playtest snapshots record build, starting setup, configured values and active spring profile. Incomplete records are marked incomplete. A defaults diff is review material, never an automatic promotion.
